title: Laal Meray Bichray Hain Bhaiya
body:
Laal meray bichray hain bhaiya kahin say lao unhain ..
Sani)
Meray Ibrahim Mohammad ko dhoondti hoon main batao unhain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Kufa walo nay sitam jo hai kiya Muslim per
Ho na jaye wo sitam un per main tarapti hoon bachao unhain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jaisay ro ro kay sisak kay main sada daiti hoon
Day kay awaz meri tarah bhaiya Abbas bulao unhain ..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Aik farayad hai madar ki musalmano say
Meray masoom saharay hain aisay mujh say na chupao unhain..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zikar un ka hi ibadat hai meri sham o Sehar
Zulm Jin Pak yateemo per haye hua aisa sunao unhain ..
